definitions.gloss: attention seeker; show-off; person who loves the spotlight
definitions.explanation: A person who constantly wants to stand out and be noticed. Formed from the verb 目立つ (to stand out) + たがる (to want to) + 屋 (person characterized by a trait).

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{目立|めだ}ちたがり{屋|や}だ。
examples.english: That kid is an attention seeker.

examples.japanese: {目立|めだ}ちたがり{屋|や}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{派手|はで}→派手：03563_hade⟧な⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ている→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: She's an attention seeker and always wears flashy clothes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{目立|めだ}ちたがり{屋|や}だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧になって⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}いた→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧。
examples.english: I was an attention seeker as a child, but I calmed down as an adult.

notes:
A compound word built from three parts: ⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧ (to stand out) + たがる (to want to, to be eager to) + ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (person characterized by a trait). The suffix ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ in this sense describes someone who habitually does something, often with a mildly critical or affectionate tone.

FORMATION PATTERN:
The ~たがり⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ pattern creates words for people who want to do something:
- {目立|めだ}ちたがり{屋|や}: wants to stand out
- {寂|さび}し⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: easily lonely
- {怖|こわ}⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: easily scared
- {恥|は}ずかし⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: easily embarrassed, shy

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {目立|めだ}ちたがり{屋|や}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: an attention-seeking personality
- {目立|めだ}ちたがり{屋|や}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: an attention-seeking person

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見栄|みえ}っ{張|ぱ}り→見栄っ張り：20410_mieppari⟧: show-off — focused on appearing superior or wealthier
- {自己顕示欲|じこけんじよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: having a strong desire for self-display — more formal
- ⟦{出|で}たがり→出る：00513_deru⟧: someone who wants to appear (on TV, in public) — similar but focused on appearing in media
